Species List for the Swamp Flora of O'Hares Creek Catchment

	Nomenclature follows that accepted by the National Herbarium of 
New South Wales (Jacobs & Pickard 1981, Jacobs & Lapinpuro 1986, 
Harden 1990, 1991). In addition, informal intraspecific taxa are 
recognised within Hakea dactyloides, H.ÿteretifolia and Leptospermum 
trinervium. The multi-stemmed form of H.ÿdactyloides is the 
lignotuberous form of Harden (1991). Eight-letter species codes are the
first four letters of generic and specific epithets, respectively. The
eighth letter may represent the first letter of subspecific or varietal 
epithets or names of informal taxa, as appropriate. Where two species 
would otherwise have identical codes the eighth letter represents the 
first different letter in the specific epithet. Fire-response group codes 
are explained in Fig. 3.4. Where the second-last letter of the code is 
underlined the propagule storage is uncertain and may be soil 
storage (S) or no store (N). Family names have the suffix 'aceae' 
omitted for brevity.
